sources.name: CA ADU Laws - AB 68
sources.notes: By-right ADU construction on residential lots. Streamlined ministerial approval. Limits local parking requirements.

sources.name: CA ADU Laws - SB 13
sources.notes: Caps ADU impact fees for units under 750 SF. Reduces owner-occupancy enforcement until 2025. Allows delay of utility connection fees.

sources.name: CA ADU Laws - AB 881
sources.notes: Eliminates local requirements for lot-size minimums, replacement parking for garage conversions, and non-objective design standards.

sources.name: CA ADU Laws - AB 2221
sources.notes: Clarifies that ADUs cannot be required to have fire sprinklers if primary residence does not have them. Limits setback requirements.

sources.name: CA ADU Laws - SB 897
sources.notes: Increases max ADU height to 18 ft (detached) or 25 ft (attached/within half-mile of transit). Allows 2-story ADUs. Allows ADUs on multifamily lots.

sources.name: CA ADU Laws - AB 916
sources.notes: Allows JADUs to include internal connections with primary residence. Clarifies JADU efficiency kitchen requirements.

sources.name: CA ADU Laws - AB 1033
sources.notes: Allows local jurisdictions to permit separate sale of ADUs as condominiums (ADU condo conversion). Opt-in by local government.

sources.name: CA ADU Laws - SB 477
sources.notes: Requires pre-approved ADU plans statewide. Jurisdictions must create programs for standard ADU designs with ministerial approval.

sources.name: CA ADU Laws - AB 976
sources.notes: Permanently removes owner-occupancy requirement for ADUs (was temporarily suspended by SB 13 through 2025).

sources.name: LADBS Standard Plan Program
sources.notes: 90+ pre-approved ADU designs for LA City. Expedited plan check (1-2 days). Covers studio, 1-bed, 2-bed units. Both attached and detached designs.

sources.name: LADBS ADU Guidelines
sources.notes: LA City ADU permit requirements, fees, setbacks, and process. Includes garage conversion guidelines.

sources.name: LA County Pre-Approved ADU Plans
sources.notes: 3 pre-approved ADU plans for unincorporated LA County. Streamlined permitting for qualifying lots.

sources.name: LA County ADU Ordinance
sources.notes: Unincorporated LA County ADU rules including max size (1,200 SF), setbacks (4 ft rear/side), height limits, and parking requirements.

sources.name: CA HCD ADU Handbook
sources.notes: Official CA Housing and Community Development ADU handbook. Comprehensive guide to state ADU law, local compliance, and technical assistance.

sources.name: CA HCD ADU Technical Assistance Memos
sources.notes: HCD memos to local jurisdictions on ADU ordinance compliance. Includes enforcement actions against non-compliant cities.

sources.name: CA Government Code Section 65852.2
sources.notes: Primary ADU statute in CA Government Code. Codifies all ADU legislation requirements. Reference for local ordinance compliance.

sources.name: CA Government Code Section 65852.22 (JADU)
sources.notes: Junior ADU (JADU) statute. Max 500 SF, must be within existing primary residence footprint, requires owner occupancy in one unit.
